title: Procedural Walk Cycle Generator
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a procedural walk cycle generator using Three.js. The scene features a stick-figure character whose limbs are animated procedurally (no keyframe animations or imported models).

Scene Setup:
- Dark gray background (0x1a1a1a), perspective camera at position (0, 1.5, 5) looking at origin
- Ambient light (0x404040) and directional light (0xffffff, intensity 1.0) from (5, 10, 5)
- A ground plane (20x20, color 0x333333) at y=0
- Grid helper on the ground for visual reference

Character Construction (stick figure using cylinders and spheres):
- Head: sphere radius 0.15 at top
- Torso: cylinder height 0.6, radius 0.05
- Upper arms (2): cylinders length 0.35, radius 0.03
- Lower arms (2): cylinders length 0.3, radius 0.025
- Upper legs (2): cylinders length 0.4, radius 0.04
- Lower legs (2): cylinders length 0.38, radius 0.03
- All limbs connected via pivot points (empty Object3D nodes) for rotation
- Character colored with MeshPhongMaterial, body 0x44aaff, joints 0xffaa00

Procedural Walk Cycle:
- Use sine/cosine functions to drive joint rotations
- Walk speed parameter controls the frequency of the cycle (default 1.0)
- Stride length parameter controls amplitude of leg swing (default 0.6 radians)
- Arm swing amplitude is 60% of leg swing amplitude
- Hip vertical bob: slight up/down sinusoidal motion (amplitude 0.05 units)
- Phase offset: left limbs are 180 degrees out of phase with right limbs
- Knee bend: lower leg bends backward (positive X rotation) during swing phase, max 0.8 radians
- The character should move forward in world space based on speed, wrapping back to start at x=-5 when reaching x=5

UI Controls (DOM overlay, top-left):
- Speed slider (range 0.2 to 3.0, step 0.1, default 1.0) with label showing current value
- Stride slider (range 0.2 to 1.2, step 0.05, default 0.6) with label showing current value
- Play/Pause button (toggles animation)
- Reset button (returns character to origin, resets cycle phase to 0)
- Style dropdown: 'normal', 'march', 'sneak' which adjusts parameters:
  - normal: default values
  - march: stride 1.0, knee bend max 1.2, arm swing 80% of leg
  - sneak: stride 0.3, speed 0.5, hip bob 0.02, character crouches (torso tilts forward 0.2 rad)

State Management - expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- isPlaying: boolean
- speed: current speed value
- stride: current stride amplitude in radians
- style: 'normal'|'march'|'sneak'
- cyclePhase: current phase of walk cycle (0 to 2*PI, wrapping)
- characterX: world X position of character
- hipY: current Y position of hip joint
- leftLegAngle: current rotation of left upper leg around X axis
- rightLegAngle: current rotation of right upper leg around X axis
- leftKneeAngle: current rotation of left lower leg (knee bend)
- rightKneeAngle: current rotation of right lower leg (knee bend)
- leftArmAngle: current rotation of left upper arm
- rightArmAngle: current rotation of right upper arm
- frameCount: number of animation frames elapsed
- lastDeltaTime: last frame delta in seconds

Animation must use requestAnimationFrame with delta time. The cycle phase increments by (speed * deltaTime * 2). All angles must be in radians. Ensure no NaN values in any state field.
physics_constraints: Limb phase relationships must be maintained: left and right limbs 180 degrees out of phase. Knee angle must always be >= 0 (knees don't bend forward). Hip bob follows sinusoidal pattern at 2x cycle frequency. Character wraps position at boundaries [-5, 5]. All joint angles must remain within physically plausible bounds.
